credit.credit-words: Peace, Love, and Unity I
A 200+ National Anthem Medley
"While I was browsing through information of national anthems on Wikipedia.org.
I was curious.
'What if I combined all the National Anthems in to one?' I said to myself.
And thus, Peace, Love, and Unity was born.
Upon looking back, I learnt a lot of things.
National anthems are about becoming one with the people, on the land we share.
The ways of expressing may take different songs,
May take different languages;
May take different genres;
But in the end,
It's all the same thing.
We sing in harmony,
Upon the land we stand on,
For the achievements of our ancestors,
For them,
For us,
For all of our souls as one,
To have Peace, Love, and Unity."
-Kiro- a.k.a. Cheong Po Yao
There are a few things that I wish to specify, before you play this medley.
1. This medley contains 208 national anthems of 194 recognized countries, and 9 unofficial countries.
(to be changed upon completion)
The only country(s) that is(are) not included is(are):
The Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (due to obvious controversies and no sheet music)
Kyrgyzstan (no sheet music)
South Sudan (no sheet music)
3. If your country, anthem has lower volume than others (
or
), it's generally for musical effect, instead of
a lack of affection for the countries.
4. I started this project at 23rd October, 2015 when I was 14.
5. If you country's anthem starts at a weird transition (i.e. halfway through the chorus or verse), feel free to
contact me on the MuseScore page you downloaded this sheet music.
6. This composition is free for anyone to use. Just credit me if you use it. But:
I: Do not add lyrics/edit this and republish.
II: Do not upload this to YouTube. I'l be the one doing that.
III: Give credit if you covered this. (also feel free to post a link at the MuseScore page!)
IV: If you want a full cover of your anthem, comment and I'll -try to- make it.
7. This medley is around two hours long. Play at own risk! :O
